name: oa-manager
description: Gestor de Objetivos de Aprendizaje — monorepo (backend Express + frontend React)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
